# Melodine v2.0.1

This is the first public v2 release of Melodine: a substantial rewrite of v1 focused on turning
YouTube audio into a clean, maintainable local music library rather than just downloading the first
matching video.

## Highlights

- **Studio-first search** — Anti-MV scoring prefers Topic/official-audio candidates and uses title,
  duration and intent signals before selecting a source.
- **SponsorBlock cuts** — configured non-music segments can be removed after audio extraction.
- **Synced lyrics** — LRCLIB exact/fuzzy matching, synced-first ranking, embedded lyrics and optional
  sidecar `.lrc` files.
- **Artwork and metadata cleanup** — square artwork processing plus optional iTunes/MusicBrainz
  enrichment.
- **Audio profiles and loudness normalization** — Opus, MP3, M4A/AAC and FLAC output with optional
  two-pass FFmpeg loudness normalization.
- **Persistent local library** — SQLite history, variant-aware duplicate detection, watchlists,
  resumable queues and M3U8 export.
- **Dual interface** — interactive Rich TUI and scriptable Typer CLI with the same underlying
  services.

## Reliability work in 2.0.1

The v2 branch went through two review/hardening passes before release. The final version includes:

- correct yt-dlp SponsorBlock / extraction / ModifyChapters staging;
- offline-enforced tests that fail on accidental real network access;
- graceful Ctrl+C handling in both TUI and headless CLI;
- persisted unfinished batch queues and `melodine get --resume`;
- CLI batch flags applied consistently to `.txt` playlists;
- variant-aware dedup for live/remix/cover/instrumental versions;
- thread-safe LRCLIB rate limiting and synced-lyrics preference;
- CI across Python 3.10–3.13 on Ubuntu and Windows.

The release was validated by **235 tests** plus Ruff in GitHub Actions.

## Installation

Requires Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg in `PATH`.

```bash
pipx install "git+https://github.com/KROFN/melodine.git@v2.0.1"
```

or:

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/KROFN/melodine.git@v2.0.1"
```

Then run:

```bash
melodine
```

The `mld` alias is installed as well.

> The PyPI name `melodine` belongs to an unrelated project. The distribution name for this
> project is `krofn-melodine`; this release is currently installed directly from GitHub.

## Upgrading from v1

- v1 `config.yaml` is migrated into the v2 configuration model;
- the existing SQLite database is migrated in place and history is preserved;
- the original seven themes remain available;
- `python main.py` remains as a compatibility launcher.

The **internal Python API changed** significantly. The supported user interfaces are the
`melodine` / `mld` CLI and TUI.

For an important existing library, back up `config.yaml` and `melodine.db` before the first v2
run.

## Audio-quality note

YouTube audio is already lossy. FLAC output avoids another lossy codec step after decoding, but it
cannot restore information absent from the source.
